name: Blue Horrors
equipped_with: Every model is equipped with: Coruscating flames.

option_groups.header: One model may be equipped with
Another model may be equipped with

abilities: Deepstrike, Daemon, Daemonic instability, Infantry, Mark of Tzeentch, Terrifying(-1)

Icon of Chaos: A friendly Daemon unit arriving within 3" of the bearer via Deep strike does not scatter. If the arriving unit has the same Mark of Chaos as the bearer, it can instead be placed within 6". Can only be used if the bearer was on the battlefield at the start of the battle round and has not moved more than 12" during that battle round yet.
Instrument of Chaos: The unit reduces the amount of Mortal Wounds suffered from Daemonic Instability by 1.
Split: After each activation in which the unit lost at least one Blue Horror, roll a die for each lost model. On a 4+, a killed Blue Horror is replaced by a Brimstone Horror.
